title: On-demand prestage & backfill allocator schedule — Q2 2026
content:
Purpose:
This sheet captures a tactical plan for 'prestage' allocator pools and scheduled backfill windows across NA / EU / APAC cloud regions. The goal: reduce cold-start tail latency for bursty workloads while keeping on-demand unit cost reasonable via cohort warm-up and targeted backfill slots. This is intentionally tighter and more operational than the broader regional forecasts — it focuses on warmpool sizing, allocation multipliers, backfill SLAs and a calendarized rollout for Q2 2026.

Key assumptions:
- Primary capacity adds are Nvidia H100 and a small tranche of A10x for lower-cost embedding jobs.
- Baseline persistent fleet planned elsewhere; this sheet only tracks warmpool/prestage and short-term backfill slots (0–72h).
- Target steady-state utilization for warmpools = 55–75% to balance cost vs availability.
- Burst-fallback strategy: if warmpool utilization >85% for 4 consecutive 10-minute windows, trigger backfill window (30–120 min) and scale multiplier.
- Pricing: warmpool GPUs billed as reserved vaporized units (internal accounting) — cost tradeoffs evaluated in Optimize playbook.

Short notes on table fields:
- Planned GPUs (add): number of devices expected to be introduced to the region during the quarter for warmpool/backfill support.
- Warmpool GPUs (prestage): subset of planned GPUs kept in pre-warmed state (containers + KV warmed) to satisfy sub-second cold start SLA.
- Target util (%): utilization target for warmpool to determine efficiency.
- Scale-trigger (%): threshold to kick an automated backfill.
- Backfill window (min): typical duration for supplemental capacity to be provisioned in burst fallback.
- Cohort: cohort label for staggered warmup to avoid simultaneous warming spikes.

Rollout timeline (calendarized, high level):
- Week 1 (2026-04-05 to 2026-04-11): Deploy prestage allocator feature flag to canary NA us-west1 with alpha cohort (40 GPUs). Monitoring hooks and tracing enabled.
- Week 3 (2026-04-19 to 2026-04-25): Validate alpha: warmpool hit rate >70% and tail latency reduction >90th pctl by 20% — if green, expand to us-east4 (beta cohort).
- Week 6 (2026-05-10 to 2026-05-16): EU pilot start (gamma + delta cohorts) with canary backfill windows (short 30–45m) to validate cross-cloud provisioning latency.
- Week 9 (2026-05-31 to 2026-06-06): APAC staggered rollout (epsilon + zeta), enable regional routing policy to prefer prestage when application tier = 'interactive'.
- Week 12 (2026-06-21 to 2026-06-27): Full Q2 wrap: runback test (simulate 2x burst for 90 minutes) and capture metrics for Optimize review.

Operational runbook snippets (for on-call/SRE):
1) Prestage health check (manual): 
   - Check warmpool process status: /ops/warmpool/status for region. Expected: all containers report "KV: warmed" and "last-allocate < 5m" for prestage GPUs.
   - Metrics to scan: prestage_hit_rate, prestage_tail_p95, prestage_cost_per_hour.
2) Automated backfill steps (triggered):
   - Signal to capacity allocator: add backfill_id tag, allocate + scale-multiplier = 1.5 for X minutes (X = backfill window).
   - Route traffic: prefer backfill slot for cold-key prefixes for the cohort only.
   - Post-event: run 'cohort cooldown' to avoid immediate re-triggering (cooldown = 20m).
3) Rollback (if cost or tail latency worsens):
   - Flip feature flag to 'off' and gracefully drain prestage containers.
   - Re-deploy preexisting routing policy; mark incident and tag telemetry for postmortem.

Monitoring & KPIs to collect during rollout:
- Prestage hit rate (fraction of requests served from warmpool) — target > 60% after pilot.
- End-to-end P95/P99 latency for interactive endpoints — aim for -15% P95 vs baseline.
- Cost delta: warmpool burn vs avoided cold-start token cost — tracked in Optimize sheet weekly.
- Backfill frequency and average duration — target < 3 events / region / week.

Risks and mitigations:
- Risk: synchronized cohort warmups spike quota and cause cross-az throttles. Mitigation: stagger cohort warmup windows by 10–20 minutes and preflight quota checks 24h prior.
- Risk: backfill provisioning latency > 2 minutes in some cloud zones. Mitigation: increase warmpool fraction in those zones and open support ticket with provider.
- Risk: cost overruns if utilization stays too low. Mitigation: implement auto-shrink policy for warmpools when 7-day avg util < 40%.

Next steps / action items (owners):
- Aisha: finalize prestage feature-flag rollback criteria doc (due 2026-03-10).
- Liam: add automated smoke tests for warmpool health (ENG-1342) and land PR by 2026-03-20.
- Marco: coordinate quota reservations and vendor escalation for asia-northeast1 by 2026-04-01.
- Sofia: wire Optimize cost sheet to weekly delta feed and add backfill KPI dashboard (due 2026-04-15).

Notes / open questions (for follow-up):
- Should we extend warmpool to include A100 in regions with legacy customers? (open)
- Can we amortize some prestage cost by offering limited 'reserved warmpool credits' to enterprise customers? (ops + sales discussion)
